sentences.en: Chestnuts have to be boiled for at least fifteen minutes.
sentences.zh: 栗子至少要煮十五分钟。

sentences.en: Parents who beat their children really make my blood boil.
sentences.zh: 父母打孩子让我气得怒火中烧。

sentences.en: I cannot even boil water, much less roast a turkey.
sentences.zh: 我连水都煮不开，更别提烤火鸡了。
